title: A Gentle Touch
player_task: Interpret simplified altitude and descent-rate cues to select safe automated descent corrections.
learning_intent: Relate sensing, velocity control, and shock absorption to a soft landing.
evidence_chain: descent telemetry|successful touchdown|surface images and engineering data
simplification_note: Surveyor 1 was autonomous; the player interprets and sequences simplified decisions rather than manually flying it.

title: The Echo That Never Sleeps
player_task: Align laser pulses, separate return signal from noise, and infer distance from round-trip time.
learning_intent: Explain how passive retroreflectors support precise lunar ranging without onboard power.
evidence_chain: outgoing laser pulse|returned photons|light travel time|Earth–Moon distance
simplification_note: The game compresses real observatory timing, atmospheric corrections, repeated measurements, and uncertainty analysis.

title: Farther Than Footsteps
player_task: Plan a geology traverse within time, range, sample value, and safe-return constraints.
learning_intent: Show how mobility expanded the area and diversity of lunar field geology.
simplification_note: The game condenses three real traverses and many operational constraints into one short route-planning activity.

title: A Question in the Soil
player_task: Compare soil-experiment results and choose only the conclusion supported by the combined evidence.
learning_intent: Practice scientific caution when different tests do not produce one simple answer.
simplification_note: The encounter does not reproduce laboratory protocols and must not claim that Viking definitively proved or disproved all Martian life.

title: Clues Beneath the Wheel
player_task: Choose a route, inspect exposed material, and match instrument evidence to a past-water interpretation.
learning_intent: Connect rover movement and instrument measurements to geological evidence.
simplification_note: The encounter focuses on one evidence story from a mission that produced many different observations.

title: Air Thin as a Whisper
player_task: Choose rotor, energy, altitude, and terrain parameters for a short autonomous flight.
learning_intent: Relate thin atmosphere, lightweight design, rotor speed, autonomy, and energy limits.
evidence_chain: flight plan|rotor lift|navigation images|completed flight data
simplification_note: The player plans high-level constraints; Ingenuity controlled flight autonomously rather than through real-time piloting from Earth.

title: Landing Where No Landing Was Planned
player_task: Use mapping observations to refine a controlled descent and preserve final measurements.
learning_intent: Connect orbital mapping, weak gravity, adaptive engineering, and asteroid composition.
evidence_chain: orbital images and ranging|shape and gravity model|descent|surface measurements
simplification_note: The real descent involved detailed navigation and engineering operations; the spacecraft was not designed as a lander.

title: Power for the Unknown
player_task: Allocate declining power among instruments and prioritize a small interstellar data stream.
learning_intent: Explain how power, distance, bandwidth, and ground antennas shape an extended mission.
evidence_chain: instrument power|fields-and-particles measurement|encoded signal|Deep Space Network reception
simplification_note: Instrument availability and power decisions change; release copy must be rechecked against current NASA status pages.

title: One Chance at Pluto
player_task: Schedule observations during a fast flyby with limited pointing time, storage, and downlink.
learning_intent: Show why years of preparation were required for a brief encounter and long data return.
simplification_note: The game compresses a complex preprogrammed observation campaign and lengthy data return into a short sequence.
